artChoices: Small recoil and brief one-frame muzzle flashes; no translation or scaling of the pit, floor or base plate.
AA barrels have separate recoil/flash tracks with phase offsets for a readable unsynchronized four-gun cycle; these offsets are an animation choice.
Tracking is a smooth repeating local traverse around the visible mounting pivot. No elevation change is implied by this nadir-view clip.
Ammunition boxes follow the upper gun assembly during traverse; no speculative side-ejected cases or visible internal bolt cycle.
Both cardinal headings and local tracking arcs use the same fixed pit artwork. Extra transparent canvas prevents south-facing weapons and flashes from clipping.
